scope: Dimensioned US reference for cross-jurisdiction AASHTO I-beam comparisons; not proof of current adoption by another country.

records.title_original: PCI Bridge Design Manual, Appendix B-7: AASHTO I-Beams
records.title_en: PCI reference sections for AASHTO I-beam Types I–VI
records.locator: November 2011 Appendix B-7, PDF p1: D1–D6/B1–B6 dimension table and section properties; Appendix B-8, PDF p2: individual shapes
records.observed_dimensions: All six 12-dimension inch rows and published A, centroid-from-soffit and Ixx transcribed. Type IV example: 54 in deep, 20 in top width, 26 in bottom width, 789 in² area. Exact gross polygons reproduce printed properties within tabular rounding.
records.missing_information: Current state/producer adoption and dimensions must be verified separately. A foreign AASHTO designation, or use of AASHTO LRFD loads, does not establish identical geometry.
